SHOT: Worn ring frame, 4:5: the BACK OF ONE HAND held up flat and square to camera in front of the collarbone, fingers together and relaxed, the whole hand and the wrist in frame, so the ring on the ring finger is seen at its true small size against the hand.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: hand, fingers, wrist, collarbone and shoulder.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn on ONE finger only (the ring finger): the pearl and the gold nugget both sit on top of that one finger, side by side across its width, long axes along the finger; the band wraps that finger only; nothing on the middle or little finger; any other jewellery in IMAGE 2 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN TOI-ET-MOI RING: a slim polished gold band that does NOT close. At one end ONE long BAROQUE shell pearl, elongated, about twice as long as it is wide, with soft parallel ridges across it and a white lustre, held in a thin gold rim that follows its wavy outline. At the other end ONE smooth polished gold oval NUGGET, a solid domed bean with no frame. The pearl and the nugget are two separate heads with a small gap, never joined; on the hand both sit on top of ONE finger, side by side across its width, their long axes running ALONG the finger. Exactly one pearl and one gold nugget; the pearl is long and ridged, never round, never smooth; the nugget is plain polished gold, never textured, never in a bezel or cup, never set with stones; the two heads are never joined by a bar; no other stones.

SCALE TEST: Worn on ONE finger only, at its TRUE SMALL size: the pearl is about 15mm long, a little shorter than the finger is wide, and about 7mm wide; the pearl and the nugget side by side TOGETHER are only as wide as that one finger and never overhang it; the nugget is a little shorter and narrower than the pearl; on the hand the ring reads small and dainty, a ring for one finger; never larger. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A LOZENGE-SHAPED OPENWORK RING: the front is an openwork panel shaped like a square turned 45 degrees (a lozenge with near-right-angle corners): one corner points toward the fingertip, one toward the knuckle and one down each side of the finger, about 16mm corner to corner, its scalloped edges sloping in straight lines between the corners; behind it a narrow plain gold band about 2mm wide goes round the finger. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.
